lines:
Hierarchy-first design browser with tree navigation, C4 level controls, breadcrumbs, local UML and UI mockup artifact tabs, source panels, inspector, and traceability navigation between linked artifacts.

Approved Markdown extension (implementation pending): Add a discoverable project-level Documents entry and Markdown artefact entries within linked architecture scopes; project documents need no invented C4 parent. Open task/QA/document links directly in an editable Markdown panel showing title, content and relevant associations/backlinks. Reuse the existing EasyMDE MarkdownEditor/VersionedMarkdownEditor in src/main.tsx (extract shared code if appropriate); preserve its formatting toolbar and Preview capability rather than adding a second editor library. Adapt draft guarding to canonical design readTokens. Support create, edit, preview, rename title, associate, detach and guarded delete; show saving/saved/error/conflict states with accessible keyboard navigation. Keep raw agent-generation notices out of the canonical editable body. Preserve drafts during polling, navigation, backend changes, conflicts and failed saves; no cleanup/unmount autosave may overwrite or resurrect discarded/deleted content. Reuse the application's rendering/link policy and prevent executable HTML or unsafe URL navigation. Show official documents in task/QA pickers and backlinks; open stable typed identities, not file paths.
